## Standing operator rules
Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train. Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`. Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix incorrect Quebec QST calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. OpenTelemetry tracing is superseded and paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Canonical billing fields: `args.currency`, `args.status`; `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded. Staging `REDIS_URL`: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded. Kafka: `orders.v1`→`orders.v2`, `orders-v1`→`orders-v2`. Idempotency key: `test-inv-1042`; load key: `load-42`; invoice: `INV-1042`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Bespoke invoice-list groups duplicated `--currency/-c`. Retrying all `HTTPStatusError`s incorrectly retried 4xx. Raising Celery visibility timeout to 6 hours hid stuck jobs.

## Plan and progress
- [IN PROGRESS] Fix Quebec QST.
- [PENDING] Run `pytest -q tests/test_tax.py`.
- [PENDING] Kafka migration steps 4–9; steps 2–3 exited 0 but produced no observed result.
- [DONE] Full suite: 318 passed, 4 skipped.

## Recent work
Fixed the invoice-sync race by conditionally completing matching idempotency records. Integration tests passed 8/8, unit tests 14/14, and concurrent regression coverage was added. Load testing produced 8 submissions, 192 replays, no 500s, and one completed row.
